tasks.title: Update runbook.md and PLANIO_WIKI.textile with the verified end-to-end mail flow
tasks.accept: grep -qi 'dkimpy-milter' docs/runbook.md && grep -qi 'stalwart-cli' docs/runbook.md && grep -qi 'home.opendesk-edu.org' docs/runbook.md && grep -qiE 'DNS|Stalwart' docs/PLANIO_WIKI.textile
tasks.acceptance_prose: runbook.md documents the working flow Postfix -> LDAP (openldap) -> dkimpy-milter (DKIM s1) -> Stalwart (JMAP), incl. stalwart-cli apply snippets and DNS record locations; PLANIO_WIKI.textile reflects current architecture

tasks.title: Create ADR-005 documenting the Stalwart LDAP directory decision
tasks.acceptance_prose: ADR documents: Domain.directoryId (per-domain LDAP) is Enterprise-gated, global Authentication.directoryId is community, eval uses internal directory with Postfix doing LDAP validation, custom filters needed for UniMrAccount/UniMrEmail schema

tasks.title: Create Stalwart backup: CronJob manifest + backup shell script
tasks.accept: bash -n scripts/backup-stalwart.sh && python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('k8s/scs-k3s/stalwart-backup.yaml'))" && grep -qi 'stalwart.db' scripts/backup-stalwart.sh
tasks.acceptance_prose: CronJob backs up /data/stalwart.db (SQLite WAL checkpoint) of the stalwart deployment in namespace opendesk-edu; script is bash-syntax-clean and references the database path

tasks.title: Create dkimpy-milter Dockerfile with syslog relay + build script for air-gap registry
tasks.accept: bash -n scripts/build-dkimpy-milter.sh && test -f dockerfiles/dkimpy-milter/Dockerfile && grep -qiE 'syslog|busybox|rsyslog' dockerfiles/dkimpy-milter/Dockerfile
tasks.acceptance_prose: Multi-stage Dockerfile installs python + pymilter + dkimpy-milter and a syslog relay (/dev/log -> stdout) so kubectl logs shows signing events; build script pushes to 172.17.209.143:5000 with docker.io/library/dkimpy-milter tag

tasks.title: Capture live Stalwart deployment as manifest + write 0.16.16->0.16.18 upgrade runbook
tasks.accept: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('k8s/scs-k3s/stalwart.yaml'))" && grep -q 'v0.16' k8s/scs-k3s/stalwart.yaml && grep -qi '0.16.18' docs/UPGRADE_STALWART_01618.md
tasks.acceptance_prose: stalwart.yaml mirrors the live deployment (image v0.16.16, env STALWART_PORT/STALWART_HOSTNAME, NO recovery admin) incl. service+config; upgrade doc covers air-gap image push (localhost:5001 mirror, docker.io/stalwartlabs/stalwart path) and regression checklist
